description: Shared test vectors for docs/agent-identity/CONTRACT.md. Timestamps are Unix seconds. Signatures are ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256, raw r||s, generated with RFC 6979 deterministic nonces. Keys are test-only.
evaluation: For http_signature.cases, a verifier holding the `registered` certificates, an empty nonce store and clock `now` returns `expected` (`ok` or a §5.4 error code) for a request to `endpoint` (renew, connect, confirm or check-in) with the case's `method`. `sequences` run their steps in order against one nonce store. Certificate validity follows the §6 table and §8.2 (renew grace), §5.5 and §5.6 (confirm and check-in: pending or current, unexpired, no grace) and §6 step 4; a certificate is unexpired while `now ≤ notAfter` (§6). In negative cases, `signature_base` is the base that was originally signed, not what a verifier recomputes from the altered request. Key-reuse rules depend on server state and are covered by the conformance suite, not by these vectors.

valid.description: P-256 key, CN=ignored, no attributes (empty attributes set), ecdsa-with-SHA256, valid self-signature: the CSR an agent sends (§4)

valid_with_empty_extension_request.description: P-256 key, CN=ignored, an extensionRequest attribute holding an empty Extensions sequence, ecdsa-with-SHA256, valid self-signature. An agent never sends it (§4), but the server takes only the public key and the self-signature from a CSR (§4), so an attribute, even one that breaks RFC 5280's SIZE (1..MAX), must not make it refuse the CSR

ecdsa_with_sha384.description: P-256 key, valid self-signature, but ecdsa-with-SHA384
